pdf.js (pdfjs-dist) — vendored
==============================
Upstream:   https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
Package:    https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist
Version:    6.0.227
Source URL: https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-6.0.227.tgz
Reviewed:   2026-06-19
License:    Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE in the upstream package)

Why vendored
------------
peerd reads PDFs the agent encounters through the read_doc runner tool
(peerd-runtime/tools/defs/read-doc.js). pdf.js is Mozilla's browser-native
PDF engine; its text layer extraction is the DEFAULT, always-available
reader (no download). Extraction runs in the OFFSCREEN document
(offscreen/pdf-extract.js) — pdf.js needs a Worker, which a service worker
cannot host. The heavier OCR path for scanned PDFs is a separate, opt-in
runtime download (peerd-runtime/pdf/ocr-store.js), the Moonshine-voice
pattern.

Files committed
---------------
  pdf.min.mjs           — the main API (getDocument, getTextContent, …)
  pdf.worker.min.mjs    — the parser worker; loaded via GlobalWorkerOptions
                          .workerSrc as an extension URL ('self' under the
                          offscreen CSP). Module worker (type:'module').
  wasm/jbig2.wasm       — JBIG2 image decoder selected by the parser worker
  wasm/jbig2_nowasm_fallback.js
                        — exact upstream no-WASM fallback for JBIG2
  wasm/openjpeg.wasm    — JPEG 2000 / JPX image decoder selected by the worker
  wasm/openjpeg_nowasm_fallback.js
                        — exact upstream no-WASM fallback for JPEG 2000 / JPX
  wasm/LICENSE_*        — upstream decoder and pdf.js integration licenses

We commit the minified `build/` API and worker plus only the `wasm/` children
that worker selects for scanned JBIG2/JPX pages. The .map files, unminified
builds, pdf.sandbox.* (form-scripting; unused), viewer, qcms, QuickJS, and
cmaps/standard_fonts are intentionally omitted. CJK cmaps / non-embedded
standard fonts are a known follow-up if a PDF needs them (getDocument
cMapUrl/standardFontDataUrl). All decoder URLs are fixed extension URLs;
document extraction never fetches code from the network.

Update procedure
----------------
  1. Pick the target version V from https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist
  2. curl -sSL "https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-V.tgz" -o pdfjs.tgz
  3. tar -xzf pdfjs.tgz
  4. Copy package/build/{pdf.min.mjs,pdf.worker.min.mjs} and the four named
     package/wasm decoder files plus their LICENSE_* files above.
  5. Recompute SHA-384/256 and paste them above:
       openssl dgst -sha384 -binary FILE | openssl base64 -A
  6. Update the Version / Source URL / tarball SHA lines.
  7. Smoke-test read_doc on a born-digital PDF and a scanned one.
